other_conditions: Annual family income must not exceed Rs.40,000 in rural areas or Rs.60,000 in urban areas
Eligibility is confirmed by BPL/AAY card, RSBY card, or an annual income certificate issued by the concerned Tahasildar
Patients referred from registered destitute homes, orphanages, mental asylums, or child care institutions are eligible

The patient must be admitted as an in‑patient in a government or empanelled private hospital (except cancer patients may receive chemo in Govt. Day Care Centres without formal admission and kidney‑transplant patients can receive post‑operative care up to 6 months after discharge)
Eligibility is limited to patients suffering from life‑threatening diseases as listed in Annexure‑D of the scheme guidelines
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to Rs.3 lakh for in‑patient treatment of life‑threatening diseases, with a top‑up over RSBY limits and defined sanction ceilings.
documents_required: Annual income certificate issued by the Tahasildar
